stats.label: Faster to launch their first app

settings.title: From blank canvas to live app,
settings.intro: Bento turns your workflow into a working product. Point it at your data, design the screens, set the rules — and hit publish.

features.title: Visual app canvas
features.text: Drag, drop, and connect screens on a live canvas. See your app exactly as users will, as you build — no compile step, no surprises.

features.title: Connect real data
features.text: Pull from Airtable, Google Sheets, SQL, or an API. Your app reads and writes the data you already trust, not a locked-in copy.

features.title: Logic, no code
features.text: Set permissions, approvals, and workflows with point-and-click rules. Complex automation that normally takes weeks, done in an afternoon.

features.title: Design that looks designed
features.text: Responsive, accessible components out of the box. Tune the look to your brand without touching a single stylesheet.

features.title: One-click publish
features.text: Deploy to a custom domain, add auth, and share. Every change ships to your own hosted URL with SSL in seconds.

features.title: Export anytime
features.text: Own your work. Export your app, data, and components whenever you like — Bento never holds your product hostage.

settings.title: From idea to live app,

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.text: Pick a template close to your idea — a client portal, an internal tool, a marketplace, or a landing app. Or start from a blank canvas.

steps.title: Connect your data
steps.text: Bring in the tables or sheets you already use. Bento maps them to a database your app can read and write, instantly.

steps.title: Design the flow
steps.text: Drag screens together, set the navigation, and add the logic — approvals, roles, and actions — all visually.

steps.title: Publish to production
steps.text: Hit publish, point your domain at it, and share the link. Every update goes live to the same URL in seconds.

settings.note: Most people build their first working app the same afternoon they sign up. No install, no hosting bill, no engineering ticket.

settings.title: Start free, scale
settings.intro: Every plan includes unlimited viewers and a custom domain. Upgrade when you want more power, not sooner than you need it.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: The honest answers teams ask before building with Bento.

items.question: Is Bento actually for non-technical people?
items.answer: Yes. If you can build a spreadsheet and lay out a slide, you can ship a Bento app. Engineers often use it too, but no one has to.

items.question: Can I connect my existing data?
items.answer: Bento reads and writes Airtable, Google Sheets, SQL databases, and REST APIs out of the box. Bring the source you already trust.

items.question: Is it really production-grade?
items.answer: Bento apps are hosted on our secure infrastructure with SSL, roles, audit logs, and a published API. We treat your builds with the same care as a native app.

items.question: What happens if I want to leave?
items.answer: Your app, your data, and any code are yours. Export everything on Pro and Team plans, and a Bento app isn't tied to a lifetime subscription.
